metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Album Cover with Obi Strip

retrievalProfile.description: A vintage Japanese-market vinyl record cover featuring a full-body central portrait against a solid red field with a vertical black obi strip on the left.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central male figure in a grey suit against a vibrant red background, framed on the left by a black vertical obi strip containing yellow and white Japanese text. The layout uses bold slab-serif headers and scattered sans-serif track titles, with disembodied hands appearing on the right side to create a sense of movement.
coreVisualRelationships: The black obi strip provides a heavy vertical anchor against the expansive red field.
The central figure's grey suit acts as a neutral bridge between the warm red and the cool blue/yellow text.
Scattered track titles create a rhythmic, non-linear reading path around the central subject.
Disembodied hands on the right mirror the gestures of the central figure, adding depth.
coreInvariants: Vertical black obi strip on the left edge
Full-body central subject in mid-century attire
Mix of bold slab-serif and clean sans-serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure centered vertically, scaled to occupy approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black vertical obi strip on the far left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow header, moves down the central figure, then zig-zags through the scattered track titles on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat red color surrounding the subject and text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant tomato red background providing high energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black obi strip and grey suit for structural grounding.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and light sky blue for primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background contrasted with the desaturated grey of the subject's suit.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Headers use thick, blocky slab serifs with minimal contrast.
Secondary text uses wide-set, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
Japanese text on the obi is vertically oriented and bold.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the main header features a distinctive wide leg.
Slab serifs are squared off and equal in weight to the main strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold yellow slab serif for the name, light blue sans-serif for the subtitle, and white sans-serif for track listings.
graphicDevices: Dashed border on the obi strip

preserve: Vertical text orientation on the left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif header style.
Matches the geometric sans-serif used for track titles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid red background with a full-body photo of a man in a 1960s grey suit gesturing. Add a black vertical strip on the left 20% of the frame. Include three disembodied hands on the right side in various reaching poses.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold yellow slab-serif text at the top. Add light blue sans-serif text below it. Place vertical yellow Japanese characters on the black strip. Scatter white sans-serif track names in the red space.

verificationChecks: Is the obi strip strictly vertical and black?
Is the background a flat, saturated red?
Are the track titles scattered rather than in a single column?
Is the main header a heavy slab-serif?

adjustableVariables: Background color (can be swapped for blue or green while maintaining layout)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify vertical alignment of the obi strip
Ensure the subject is isolated cleanly from the background
Confirm all-caps typesetting for English text
Check that the yellow and blue colors are vibrant
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + Vertical edge strip + Central full-body portrait + Scattered sans-serif tracklist + Bold slab-serif header.
